text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11,000 ft, and the pilot monitoring called back 12,000 ft. The pilot flying set 11,000 ft and climbed, with the aircraft rising from 8,980 ft through 10,180 ft to 11,120 ft. Crosscheck said "Readback one-two thousand, cleared one-one thousand" at 32 s, which caught the wrong readback even though the set altitude matched the clearance.
